commentary.text: 90+5' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
87' Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Garcia leaves the pitch and Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
83' The substitution is prepared. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oihan Sancet.
82' Alberto Lasarte has decided to make a change. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) replaces Iddrisu Baba Mohammed.
81' 3 - 0 Goal! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
78' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
77' Substitution. Largie Ramazani will be replaced by Lazaro (Almeria).
75' Here is a change. Ander Herrera is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
75' It will be a substitution. Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) is ready to enter the pitch as Gorka Guruzeta walks off.
73' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
72' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The game is interrupted. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
68' A substitution has been made. Ibrahima Kone is replaced by Marciano Sanca (Almeria).
68' Alberto Lasarte prepares a substitution. Gonzalo Melero is replaced by Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
68' The game has come to an end for Houboulang Mendes. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
67' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
63' 2 - 0 What a magnificent finish! Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the left side of the net!

59' What a wasted opportunity by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Luis Maximiano makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
59' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
57' The attendance for today's match is 43677.
52' Yellow card. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
51' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
47' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
45+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is about to take a corner kick.
45+1' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
42' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Dion Lopy (Almeria) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Dion Lopy (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' PENALTY APPEAL after Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

33' A brilliant individual effort! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
33' Ath Bilbao control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
29' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Largie Ramazani (Almeria).
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
25' CHANCE! Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
25' Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Adrian Embarba (Almeria), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
18' Great teamplay by Almeria as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
17' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) is caught offside!
10' 1 - 0 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
8' Yeray Alvarez is substituted due to injury. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives a chance to Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao).
7' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Neat passing move from Ath Bilbao in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

The players are on the pitch and Almeria will have the kick-off.
